card.name: Digits and separators inside numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 3 or a thousands separator (comma or space) within a number, where more digits or a range like 3 to 5 follows. Seen in dose, duration and count statements.

modes.label: Thousands separator
modes.description: A comma or space after the first digit of a four-digit number.

modes.label: Digit 3 starting a range or amount
modes.description: The numeral 3 that begins a range like 3 to 5 or a decimal like 3.75.
